第25章 玩笑不要随便开（第1页）
“我在抢救你呢！！”柳大春解释道。
“抢救个屁，你明明就是占我便宜，你抢救需要把我衣服撕开？你当我傻子呢？呜呜呜。”赵妤芳都要哭了，眼里含着泪花，急忙把衬衣合了起来，但是扣子都被刚才撕开时掉了。
“妤芳，刚才傻春真的是在救你，我看你都快不行了。”赵小小当即帮傻子说了句话来。
赵妤芳也是气死了，今天真是倒霉死了，又误喝了这傻子的，又被这傻子看了还被双手抓？
“他就是想占我便宜！！”赵妤芳不信道。
“我需要把治疗的魔气注入进去，所以只能通过那传输进去啊！！”柳大春解释了一遍。
“小小，你听，这理由，你信吗？我还内功呢，你怎么不说你会飞呢？就算你有内功吧，那你在上面揉来揉去干嘛？你当是面团呢？哼！！”
赵妤芳当时的意识是清醒的，那柳大春完全就是揉面团，哪里是治病。
“我那是一种手法。”柳大春想要解释。
“不听你解释，现在电瓶车都掉下来了，都没法去镇上了。”赵妤芳去镇上还有急事呢，今天她真是倒霉到家了。
“没事，我给你扛上去。”柳大春说道。
“你有病吧，那电瓶车那么重，你能扛上去？呵呵了。”赵妤芳一副呵呵了。
这是一个大斜坡，好在是草地，再远一点就是河了。
电瓶车就落在下面更远处，也不知好的坏的。
但这电瓶车挺大的，会很重，完全靠一个男人的力气明显是扛不上去的，赵妤芳和赵小小又是女人，没啥力气的。
“我能扛上去。”柳大春傻傻地说道。
“吹，又吹，继续吹！！”赵妤芳坐在那里，还在缓会儿，看看身体其他地方有没有痛，但发现大腿还是有些痛。

“我真能扛上去。”柳大春看了一眼电瓶车，自己现在是有修为的，这点重量应该不是问题。
“你怎么还吹牛呢？你要是能扛上去，我给你这个傻子做七天女友。”
赵妤芳随口就说了出来，因为她之前在网上经常玩这种游戏，打发一下内心的寂寞，但也基本上都是网上的，属于网恋。
现实里没有过这样，这次她习惯性的脱口而出，显然忘记了这是在线下。
“真的？还是假男友啊？？”柳大春激动了，又打量了眼赵妤芳，身材极品。
柳大春都流口水了，当傻子二十年，哪有过如此桃花运啊！这女人的手都没牵过呢！！
却可以让这种极品美女給自己当七天媳妇？
“真的啊，但你没那个本事啊！！哈哈，你是不是很想得到我啊？看你那铯眯眯的眼神，可惜啊，老娘是你吃不到的葡萄。哼。”赵妤芳高傲道。
这个女人又高贵又傲慢，是村里的单身汉可望不可及的追求。
“呵呵，小小姐姐也在，妤芳姐姐说话要算话哈。”
柳大春激动了，七天真女友，真女友啊，那就是什么事情都可以做了？？是吧？肯定是的。
柳大春心里乐着，当即就跑了过去。
赵小小和赵妤芳一脸懵逼，这傻子想干嘛呢？
柳大春跑到电瓶车那里，当即运气，一股强大的魔气凝聚在掌心。
之前说过，柳大春的修行分支修行的是力量。
这使得柳大春的力量比常人高出很多，这还只是个开始，随着修行等级越高，力量会越发恐怖，拳震山河，腿斩乾坤，均不是问题。
“这傻子要干嘛？他不会真想扛电瓶车吧？真是好白痴哦！！好傻的。”
赵妤芳无语了，这傻子就是傻子，真是弱智哦，这都能当真？？还真去试？？

Chapter 25 Don’t joke casually (page 1)
"I'm rescuing you!!" Liu Dachun explained.
"What the hell, you're obviously taking advantage of me. You need to tear my clothes apart to save me? Do you think I'm a fool? Woohoo." Zhao Yufang was about to cry. With tears in her eyes, she hurriedly closed her shirt, but all the buttons fell off when it was torn open just now.
"Yu Fang, Sha Chun was really trying to save you just now. I think you are about to die." Zhao Xiaoxiao immediately said something to the fool.
Zhao Yufang was also furious. She was so unlucky today. She drank from this fool again by mistake, was caught by this fool again, and was caught with both hands?
"He just wants to take advantage of me!!" Zhao Yufang didn't believe it.
"I need to inject the healing magic energy into it, so I can only transfer it in through that!!" Liu Dachun explained.
"Xiaoxiao, listen, do you believe this reason? I still have internal strength, why don't you say you can fly? Even if you have internal strength, then why are you kneading it? Do you think it is dough? Hmph!!"
Zhao Yufang was conscious at the time, and Liu Dachun was just kneading dough, not treating illnesses.
"That's my technique." Liu Dachun wanted to explain.
"I don't want to listen to your explanation. Now the battery car has fallen down and we can't go to town." Zhao Yufang had something urgent to do when she went to town. She was really unlucky today.
"It's okay, I'll carry it up for you." Liu Dachun said.
"Are you sick? That electric car is so heavy, can you carry it? Haha." Zhao Yufang said hehe.
This is a large slope, but fortunately it is grassland, and a little further away is the river.
The battery car fell further below, and I don't know whether it is good or bad.
But the battery car is quite big and heavy, and it is obviously impossible for a man to carry it. Zhao Yufang and Zhao Xiaoxiao are women and have little strength.
"I can carry it up." Liu Dachun said stupidly.
"Blow, blow again, keep blowing!!" Zhao Yufang sat there, still taking a moment to see if there was any pain in other parts of her body, but found that her thighs still hurt a little.
"I can really carry it up." Liu Dachun glanced at the battery car. He had some cultivation now, so the weight shouldn't be a problem.
"Why are you still bragging? If you can handle it, I will be your idiot's girlfriend for seven days."
Zhao Yufang said it casually, because she often played this kind of game online to relieve her inner loneliness, but it was basically online and belonged to online dating.
This has never happened in reality. This time she blurted out the words out of habit, apparently forgetting that this was offline.
"Really? Or a fake boyfriend??" Liu Dachun was excited and looked at Zhao Yufang again. She has a superb figure.
Liu Dachun's mouth was watering. After being a fool for twenty years, how could he have such good luck? I haven’t even held this woman’s hand before! !
But he can let such a top-notch beauty be his wife for seven days?
"It's true, but you don't have that ability!! Haha, don't you really want me? Looking at your narrow eyes, it's a pity that I am the grape you can't eat. Humph." Zhao Yufang said arrogantly.
This woman is noble and arrogant, and is an unattainable pursuit for the bachelors in the village.
"Haha, little sister is here too. Sister Yufang must keep her word."
Liu Dachun was excited. She was a true girlfriend for seven days. She was a true girlfriend, so she could do anything? ? Right? Definitely.
Liu Dachun felt happy and ran over immediately.
Zhao Xiaoxiao and Zhao Yufang looked confused. What did this fool want to do?
Liu Dachun ran to the battery car, and immediately felt a powerful demonic energy condensing in his palm.
As mentioned before, Liu Dachun’s branch of spiritual practice is spiritual practice.is strength.
This makes Liu Dachun's strength much higher than that of ordinary people. This is just the beginning. As the level of practice increases, the strength will become more terrifying. His fists can shake mountains and rivers, and his legs can cut the world. It is not a problem.
"What does this fool want to do? He doesn't really want to carry the battery car, does he? What an idiot! What a fool."
Zhao Yufang was speechless. This fool is a fool. He is really retarded. Can he take this seriously? ? Are you really going to try it? ?
